opening_paragraph: Fitness meal prep catering in Dubai from myCHEF starts at AED 1,900 per week. A vetted private chef shops, cooks and portions macro-aware meals fresh in your own kitchen — high-protein, weighed and labelled to your calorie and macro targets — so you skip the Sunday batch-cook and just train and eat. Tell us your goals, the week and your address, and during our published business hours you will usually have an itemised proposal back promptly.

new_paragraphs: Your fitness meal prep menu in Dubai is built around your macros first and your tastes second, so nothing on the plan works against your goal. Core proteins run from grilled chicken breast, lean beef and turkey to salmon, white fish, eggs and plant proteins for vegetarian plans. Carbohydrate bases — basmati and brown rice, quinoa, sweet potato, sourdough — are portioned to your training day, higher around sessions and leaner on rest days. Vegetables and healthy fats round every box out. The menu rotates so week three does not taste like week one, and it flexes for keto, high-protein, low-carb or calorie-deficit phases. Explore adjacent plans like keto catering or wellness meal prep if your goal shifts, and browse the wider meal prep range for family and household formats.

add_block.new_heading: What fitness meal prep catering includes
new_paragraphs: Fitness meal prep catering is a chef-run service that plans, cooks and portions a week of goal-aligned meals for you. It is a rolling service, not a one-off dinner. Every plan starts with your numbers: target calories, protein floor, and any cut, maintain or lean-bulk phase you are in. From there the chef builds a rotating menu, sources fresh produce and lean proteins, then cooks and vacuum-labels each portion with its weight and macros. A single weekly cycle typically covers lunches and dinners across the week, with breakfasts and snacks added on request. Because a professional caterer handles sourcing, cooking, portioning and the kitchen clean-down, the fitness meal prep catering services you receive stay consistent week to week — the same protein targets, the same portion discipline, no drift. It suits busy professionals, athletes in a training block, and households that want restaurant-grade cooking kept honest to a plan.

add_block.new_heading: How macros, allergies and dietary needs are handled
new_paragraphs: Every plan is macro-first, and the chef adjusts it around your real diet, not a generic template. Share your targets and any restrictions up front — nut-free, dairy-free, gluten-free, halal, pescatarian — and the menu is built to hit protein and calories while respecting them. Portions are weighed and labelled so you can log intake accurately, and the chef can hold to a set gram target per protein and carb source across the week. If you are cutting, we tighten calories without dropping protein; if you are in a lean-bulk, we add clean carbs around training. Prep, cooking and storage follow Dubai food-safety standards, Meals are cooked fresh and chilled, not frozen, so texture and nutrition hold. Adjustments between weeks take one message. A quick note before the next cycle re-tunes the plan.

add_block.new_heading: Gym meal prep: cooking to a plan you already follow
new_paragraphs: A gym meal plan in Dubai is a set of numbers before it is a menu. If you train to a programme, your coach has already set protein, carbohydrate and fat per day, and the job of a gym meal prep service is to hit those numbers with food you will actually eat on day five. Your chef cooks to the macros you provide, portions each meal and labels it; myCHEF does not write the programme.

What's a good meal prep for working out? In practice: protein portioned by weight rather than by eye, carbohydrates kept separate so they can be moved between training and rest days, and sauces bagged apart so a portion can be adjusted without recooking it. Macro information is provided with the meals where the partner's procedures support it, which is the part most people miss when they batch-cook for themselves.

There is no single best meal plan in the UAE, and any service claiming one is selling a template. A plan that works around a 6am gym slot in JLT looks nothing like one built around shift work or a household eating together at eight. Bring the numbers and the schedule, and the week is built around both.
